about_the_game:
Update your front view battles with some adorable pixel art creatures thanks to the RPG Monsters Asset Pack 1! Elv Games is here with a new series of battlers, this time focusing on front view monsters to challenge your heroes. 18 different dragon and plant-inspired enemy designs are ready to surprise your heroes while they explore the forests and mountains around their home town. Start your inexperienced heroes off by fighting small creatures with tall horns and little winged dragons that can barely float a foot off the ground, and teach them early about status effects by facing serenely-smiling flowers that can poison them with a burst of pollen. As your players get used to your battle system, throw buff lizardmen, petal-haired goblins, and wingless dragons covered in thick scales at them to keep your players on their toes, or use the stronger-looking monsters as a warning that your players have entered a deadlier area on accident!

Each enemy comes with 5 color variations, so you have 90 battlers to choose from! Have little wyverns be red, pink, purple, or black depending on their locations, or make the living flowers be orange, blue, brown, or purple depending on what type of debuff they can cause. Want to have a rare version of an enemy that offers a challenging fight and huge rewards? Then make sure your players recognize them when they appear by using the green color variations that have a glowing white outline! If you’ve been hoping for some new battlers for your front view fights or want to add some cute dragons to your game, check out the RPG Monsters Asset Pack 1!


Contents:

- Turn Based RPG Monsters for your game!
- Dragons & Plant Monsters!
- 18 Total Monsters!
- 5 Color Variations per Monster!
- 90 Total Monsters!
- 192x192 Pixel Sprites!
- .PNG file format!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
